tagline: A leading global diversified animal health and mineral nutrition company providing solutions for livestock, poultry, aquaculture and companion animals
hero_kpi_rationale: Remarkable 76% year-on-year growth (84.9 million USD), reflecting the positive impact of the major April 2024 acquisition and non-recurring adjustments. This metric better reflects underlying operational performance than GAAP net income.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted for exceptional items such as acquisition costs or foreign exchange fluctuations.
kpis.description: Adjusted net income increased 76% year-on-year to 84.9 million USD, driven by acquisitions and non-recurring adjustments.
kpis.signal: Very strong growth in adjusted earnings in 2025

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income rose from 2.4 million to 48.3 million USD year-on-year.
kpis.signal: Spectacular rebound in net income in 2025

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow slightly declined from 87.6 million to 80.1 million USD despite strong earnings growth.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in operating cash flow in 2025

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures to strengthen production capacity.
kpis.description: The company continues to invest 38.3 million USD in production capacity and productivity improvements.

kpis.name: Acquisition Spend
kpis.explanation: Amount paid for business acquisitions, net of cash acquired.
kpis.description: PAHC completed a major acquisition in April 2024 for 286.5 million USD, net of cash acquired.

kpis.name: Dividends Paid
